caption:
How to plan your week with AI in one prompt

Monday morning, a long list, no idea where to start. Paste it all in and let AI do the sorting:

"Here's everything on my plate this week: [BRAIN DUMP]. Fixed commitments: [MEETINGS / JOBS]. Make a day-by-day plan, max 3 priorities a day. Flag anything that won't fit."

I tried it with an example week: a quote due Wednesday, invoices to chase, an accountant call, and a full day on site Tuesday. It spotted the catch straight away: with Tuesday gone, the quote had to be written Monday.

Then you just adjust in plain English: "Move the accountant call to Friday."

Tip: always ask it to flag what won't fit. Better to move one thing on Monday than miss it on Friday.

Send this to someone who still plans the week on a napkin. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
